customer_reply:
Hi,

Thank you for reaching out to us. We understand that having a bulk archive operation in Data Ingestion is essential as your team scales to 116 users.

Currently, DataBridge Pro supports archiving entries individually. We have forwarded your request directly to our Product team as an enhancement suggestion for bulk data management operations.

We will update you on this ticket as our product roadmap develops. In the meantime, please let us know if we can assist with scripting this via our public API as a temporary automation.

Best regards,
Product Support
